record.body:
## Problem

se-workflow requires adaptive-artifacts, but install is two separate marketplace adds with no declared dependency. Users can install se-workflow alone and hit missing-runtime failures. Each repo hosts a one-plugin marketplace.

## Approach

decide at discuss — marketplace topology and how the dependency is declared.

## Exit criteria

1. Installing se-workflow through the chosen Claude marketplace path also gets adaptive-artifacts enabled (or a clear refuse with the allowlist/path named) — verified by `claude plugin validate` on changed manifests plus a documented install dry-run checklist.
2. README install steps match the chosen topology (one marketplace add or an explicit cross-marketplace allowlist) — verified by reading the Install section against the manifests.
3. Cursor install path remains documented and does not claim Claude-only dependency auto-install — verified by README review.
record.subject: plugin-dep-marketplace
